bibl.title: Flood of the Nile: New Remarks on P.Michael. 4.
bibl.seg: Gréta Kádas, Flood of the Nile: New Remarks on P.Michael. 4.

Mario Capasso, Paola Davoli & Natascia Pellé (edd.), Proceedings of the 29th International Congress of Papyrology. Lecce, 28 July - 3 August 2019 = Quaderni dell'Istituto superiore universitario di formazione interdisciplinare. 2 (Lecce, 2022) II, pp. 599-607.
bibl.note: P. Michael. 4 (= MP3 2271; LDAB 4612) is a literary description of the inundation of the Nile and its geological consequences in the Canopus area. Presents some new observations on the most problematic parts of the text delving into predominantly lexicographical peculiarities.
